title: Optional chaining ?.
description: Optional chaining ?. short-circuits to undefined the moment any link is null or undefined — for properties, methods, and indexing.

notes: Only null and undefined trigger short-circuit — 0, "", false, NaN do NOT (they are valid values).
Use ?.() for methods and ?.[i] for indexed access — the dot belongs before the bracket or paren.
Do not over-chain: if `user.address` is REQUIRED, let it throw — silently masking bugs makes them harder to find.

questions.q: What does `user?.address?.city` return if user.address is undefined?
How do you optionally call a method?
How do you optionally index an array?

exercises.prompt: Read a present property and a missing nested one.
Optional method call and optional indexed access.

L3.prompt: Write `cityOf(user)` returning `user.address.city` or undefined if any link is missing. Log `cityOf({ address: { city: "Paris" } })`, `cityOf(null)`, and `cityOf({})`.
hints: No need for if-checks — let the chain handle it.
